title: Damage Conversion Two-Step Rule & Post-Conversion Scaling Only
poe1_or_stale_trap: Assuming PoE1's Phys->Lightning->Cold->Fire->Chaos multi-step conversion chain and scaling converted damage with BOTH source (% increased Physical) and target (% increased Lightning) modifiers.
poe2_live_rule: PoE2 conversion is strictly a two-step process: (1) Skill-inherent conversion applies first, then (2) all non-skill conversion (gear, passives, Avatar of Fire) applies simultaneously to remaining unconverted damage. Damage can NEVER be converted twice, Damage over Time cannot be converted, and converted damage scales ONLY with modifiers to the final damage type (global % increased Physical grants 0% to converted Elemental damage; only local weapon % Physical increases base weapon roll prior to conversion).

title: Gain X% of Damage as Extra [Type] Scaling & Single-Hop Rule
poe1_or_stale_trap: Assuming 'Gain 20% of Physical Damage as Extra Lightning Damage' scales with global % increased Physical Damage AND can be converted again (e.g. via Call of the Brotherhood).
poe2_live_rule: Damage gained as extra X is computed before % increased/more multipliers, scales ONLY with modifiers matching the new type X (never the source type unless source == X), and cannot be subsequently converted to another damage type.

title: Weapon & Armour Quality is Multiplicative (MORE), Not Additive
poe1_or_stale_trap: Treating +20% Quality on a Martial Weapon or Armour as additive with local '% increased Physical Damage' or '% increased Armour/Evasion/ES' like PoE1.
poe2_live_rule: In PoE2, Martial Weapons gain 1% MORE Physical Damage per 1% Quality (1.20x at 20% default cap; up to 1.30x with Vaal Infusers), multiplying local % increased Physical Damage! Armours similarly gain 1% MORE local Armour, Evasion, Energy Shield, and Runic Ward per 1% Quality.

title: Player Base Critical Hit Damage Bonus is +100% (2.0x Multiplier)
poe1_or_stale_trap: Using PoE1's +50% base critical strike multiplier (150% total crit damage) or confusing 'increased critical damage bonus' with flat PoE1 '+% to Critical Strike Multiplier'.
poe2_live_rule: Players in PoE2 have an inherent +100% Critical Hit Damage Bonus (200% total damage on crit; monsters have +30%, player minions +70%). Modifiers to '% increased Critical Damage Bonus' scale that +100% base bonus multiplicatively unless stated as flat '+X% to Critical Damage Bonus'.

title: Inherent Attribute Bonuses & Zero Attributes Per Level
poe1_or_stale_trap: Assuming Strength grants Melee Physical Damage %, Dexterity grants Evasion %, and Intelligence grants Energy Shield % like PoE1.
poe2_live_rule: Characters gain 0 attributes per level (+12 Life, +4 Mana, +6 Accuracy per level). Inherent attribute bonuses are strictly single-stat: 1 Strength = +2 Maximum Life; 1 Dexterity = +6 Accuracy Rating (AccuracyPerDexBase = 6); 1 Intelligence = +2 Maximum Mana. Attribute highway nodes on the passive tree allow choosing Str, Dex, or Int freely.

title: Ranged Accuracy Distance Falloff (20 to 90 Units)
poe1_or_stale_trap: Assuming Projectile Attacks have uniform Accuracy at all screen distances like PoE1.
poe2_live_rule: PoE2 applies a distance penalty to Accuracy Rating starting beyond 20 units and reaching up to 90% less Accuracy Rating at 90 units (AccuracyFalloffStart = 20, AccuracyFalloffEnd = 90, MaxAccuracyRangePenalty = 90%).

title: Sockets Live on Skill Gems (Jeweller's Orbs), Never on Gear Links
poe1_or_stale_trap: Telling players to use Chromatic Orbs or Orbs of Fusing on Body Armour/Weapons to 6-link their skills.
poe2_live_rule: Chromatic Orbs and Orbs of Fusing do NOT exist in PoE2. Active Skill Gems inherently hold 2 Support Gem sockets and upgrade deterministically via Lesser Jeweller's Orb (->3 support sockets), Greater Jeweller's Orb (->4), and Perfect Jeweller's Orb (->5 support sockets = 6-link), or Vaal Orb corruption (+1 socket). Uncut Skill, Support, and Spirit Gems engrave any eligible gem up to their drop level.

title: Support Gem Duplication Allowed Since Patch 0.3 (Stale 0.1 Trap!)
poe1_or_stale_trap: Repeating PoE2 0.1.0's obsolete rule that 'you can only equip 1 copy of each Support Gem across your entire character', or thinking unmet support gem attributes disable the entire active skill.
poe2_live_rule: Patch 0.3.0 (The Third Edict) REMOVED the 1-per-character restriction on standard Support Gems and introduced Support Tiers I, II, and III. You CAN socket multiple copies of standard Support Gems across different skills! Restrictions in 0.5.5: (1) max 1 Support Gem per SupportGemCategory inside the SAME skill; (2) max 1 copy across your character for Lineage Supports and supports granting global benefits to persistent reservation skills; (3) unmet attributes on a support disable ONLY that support gem.
formula_expr: StandardSupportMaxPerChar = Unlimited (max 1 per Category per Skill); LineageSupportMaxPerChar = 1

title: Lineage Support Gems (Drop-Only Build-Defining Supports)
poe1_or_stale_trap: Confusing PoE2 Lineage Supports with PoE1 Awakened Support Gems or trying to engrave them from Uncut Support Gems.
poe2_live_rule: Lineage Supports (70+ variants in 0.5.5) are transformative drop-only endgame Support Gems from maps and specific bosses; they CANNOT be engraved from Uncut Support Gems, trade on the Currency Exchange (poe2scout/poe.ninja category 'lineagesupportgems'), and are strictly limited to 1 copy per Lineage Support across all character skills.

title: Spirit Reservation Resource & Per-Weapon-Set Spirit/Passives
poe1_or_stale_trap: Reserving Mana for Heralds/Auras/Banners like PoE1, or forgetting that swapping away from a Sceptre changes available Spirit.
poe2_live_rule: Mana is NOT used for standard persistent reservations; Spirit powers Permanent Minions, Heralds, Persistent Buffs, and Meta-Gems (0 base Spirit; +100 from campaign bosses; flat/percent Spirit rolls on Sceptres, Solar Amulets, and 0.5 Body Armour/Amulet BaseSpirit prefixes). Weapon Sets 1 & 2 swap instantaneously (0ms base swap delay) and maintain independent Spirit totals, active persistent toggles, and Weapon Set Passive Skill Points.

title: Meta-Gems & Per-Skill Energy Trigger Scaling
poe1_or_stale_trap: Assuming Cast on Crit / Cast on Shock triggers on a fixed 0.15s cooldown with no Energy bar like PoE1.
poe2_live_rule: Meta-Gems (Cast on Shock, Cast on Freeze, Cast on Critical, Cast on Minion Death, etc.) reserve Spirit, hold both triggered Skill Gems and Support Gems in their sockets, and build an independent Energy pool per Meta-Gem. Maximum Energy required to trigger scales directly with the cast/use time of socketed spells, and monster Power scales Energy gained.

title: Armour Mitigation Formula (10x Hit) & Applies BEFORE Elemental Resistances
poe1_or_stale_trap: Using PoE1's 5x hit divisor, early beta 12x rumours, or assuming 'Armour applies to Elemental Damage' mitigates the smaller post-resistance elemental hit like PoE1 Transcendence/Juggernaut.
poe2_live_rule: PoE2 Armour uses a 10x raw-hit divisor (90% PDR cap): DR = A / (A + 10 * Hit). Crucially, when modifiers grant '% of Armour also applies to Fire/Cold/Lightning/Chaos Damage', Armour mitigation is calculated against the LARGE pre-resistance hit BEFORE Elemental/Chaos Resistances multiply it! Also, Armour Break below 0 (Overbreak) turns Armour negative, causing targets to take MORE Physical hit damage.
formula_expr: Taken = RawHit * (1 - min(0.90, A / (A + 10 * RawHit))) * (1 - Resistance)

title: Evasion Rating Evades Attacks AND Projectile/Strike Spells (Acrobatics for AoE)
poe1_or_stale_trap: Assuming Evasion only works against Attacks and does nothing against Spells without Spell Dodge/Suppression like PoE1.
poe2_live_rule: In PoE2, Evasion works against ALL non-AoE Hits — including Melee, Projectile Attacks, AND Projectile/Non-AoE Spells (can_evade_spells = 1), capped at 95% evade chance! Unavoidable AoE slams/spells cannot be evaded UNLESS the character allocates the Acrobatics keystone ('Can Evade all Hits; 75% less Evasion Rating').
formula_expr: MonsterHitPct = clamp(round(100 * (1 - 0.95 * E / (E + 4 * EnemyAcc))), 5, 100); EvadePct = 100 - MonsterHitPct

title: Deflection Layer & Reworked Patch 0.5 Formula (40% Mitigation, 95% Cap)
poe1_or_stale_trap: Looking for PoE1 'Spell Suppression' on Dexterity gear, or using pre-0.5 uncapped/unreachable Deflection curves.
poe2_live_rule: PoE2 replaces Spell Suppression on Dex/hybrid gear with Deflection Rating. Deflection rolls independently of Evasion against ALL hits (attacks & spells, including AoE), preventing 40% of hit damage (and ailment scaling) by default. Patch 0.5 reworked the Deflection vs Enemy Accuracy formula so 95% Deflect Chance cap is reachable at endgame.

title: Passive Block Base Cap is 50% (NOT 75%) + Active Raise Shield / Parry
poe1_or_stale_trap: Assuming base maximum passive Block chance is 75% (from PoE1 or PoE2 0.1.0), or assuming all boss slams can be passively blocked without investment.
poe2_live_rule: Base maximum passive Block chance in PoE2 0.5.5 is 50% (object_inherent_base_maximum_block_%_from_ot = 50; absolute hard cap 90% with +max block passives/uniques). Blocked hits deal 0 damage, still apply Light/Heavy Stun buildup, and cannot occur while Stunned/Frozen; red-glow Boss Windup attacks are Unblockable by default. Shields grant Active 'Raise Shield' and Bucklers grant 'Parry' (100% block in 210° front arc at the cost of Heavy Stun bar buildup).
source_ref: PoB2 v0.23.1 Data/Misc.lua:L138,203 & RePoE keywords.min.json[Block, ChanceToBlock]

title: Energy Shield: Chaos Removes 2x ES (Does NOT Bypass!), Bleed & Poison BOTH Bypass ES
poe1_or_stale_trap: Saying 'Chaos hit damage bypasses Energy Shield and hits Life directly, while Bleeding damages Energy Shield first' (the PoE1 rule).
poe2_live_rule: PoE2 completely inverted PoE1's ES bypass rules: (1) Non-poison Chaos hit/DoT damage does NOT bypass Energy Shield — instead it removes TWICE (2x) as much Energy Shield! (2) Damage from BOTH Bleeding AND Poison bypasses Energy Shield to remove Life directly! Base ES Recharge is 12.5% per second after a 4.0-second delay without losing ES.
source_ref: RePoE keywords.min.json[EnergyShield, ESRecharge] & PoB2 v0.23.1 CalcDefence.lua

title: Grim Feast Reworked from ES Overflow Aura into Minion Revival Skill (Stale 0.1 Trap!)
poe1_or_stale_trap: Recommending 'Grim Feast' as a mandatory Spirit gem to double Energy Shield via ES overflow remnants (its broken 0.1.0 behavior).
poe2_live_rule: GGG disabled and completely reworked Grim Feast: it NO LONGER grants or overflows Energy Shield. In 0.5.5, Grim Feast is a Minion persistent skill that collects Remnants when your reviving minions die/expire (storing minion maximum life) and activates to mass-revive fallen minions.
source_ref: PoB2 v0.23.1 Skills/ & Patch 0.2-0.5 Skill Gems

title: Chaos Inoculation (CI): Immune to Chaos AND Bleeding
poe1_or_stale_trap: Worrying that Bleeding will instantly kill a 1-Life CI character because Bleeding bypasses Energy Shield in PoE2, or forgetting CI grants Bleed immunity.
poe2_live_rule: In PoE2, Chaos Inoculation sets Maximum Life to 1 and grants complete Immunity to BOTH Chaos Damage AND Bleeding!

title: Eldritch Battery (EB): Converts 100% Base ES to Mana & Doubles Mana Costs
poe1_or_stale_trap: Assuming Eldritch Battery moves Energy Shield to protect Mana with zero cost penalty like PoE1.
poe2_live_rule: In PoE2, Eldritch Battery converts 100% of Maximum Energy Shield into Maximum Mana (before % increased ES/Mana scaling rules apply) AND Doubles all Skill Mana Costs!

title: Mind Over Matter (MoM): 100% of Damage Taken from Mana Before Life & 50% Less Mana Recovery
poe1_or_stale_trap: Using PoE1's '40% of Hit Damage taken from Mana before Life' with no Mana recovery penalty.
poe2_live_rule: In PoE2, Mind Over Matter causes 100% of ALL Damage to be taken from Mana before Life, paired with a massive '50% less Mana Recovery Rate' penalty!

title: Glancing Blows Affects Evasion & Deflection (NOT Block!)
poe1_or_stale_trap: Recommending Glancing Blows to shield builds to 'double Block chance at 65% blocked damage taken' (the PoE1 keystone).
poe2_live_rule: In PoE2, Glancing Blows has NOTHING to do with Block! Its exact effect is: 'Chance to Evade is Unlucky; Chance to Deflect is Lucky'.

title: Avatar of Fire Converts 75% (Not 50%) of All Damage to Fire
poe1_or_stale_trap: Using PoE1's '50% of Physical, Cold and Lightning Converted to Fire'.
poe2_live_rule: In PoE2, Avatar of Fire converts 75% of ALL Damage to Fire Damage and stipulates 'Deal no Non-Fire Damage'.

title: Ignite Uses Flammability Debuff Buildup & Aggravation (No Flat PoE1 Crit-Ignite)
poe1_or_stale_trap: Assuming Critical Hits automatically have 100% chance to Ignite or rolling flat '% chance to Ignite' independent of hit size.
poe2_live_rule: In PoE2, Fire Hit damage relative to the target's Elemental Ailment Threshold inflicts 'Flammability' magnitude (8s on monsters, 4s on players); total Flammability on the target determines the chance for hits to Ignite (4s base duration, 20% of hit Fire damage/sec = 1200%/min). Ignites (like Bleeding) can also be 'Aggravated' to deal 100% extra damage (2x DPS).
formula_expr: BaseIgniteDPS = 0.20 * HitDamage (0.40 * HitDamage when Aggravated); Duration = 4s
source_ref: RePoE keywords.min.json[Ignite, Flammability, AggravateIgnite] & PoB2 Data/Misc.lua

title: Shock (20% Base), Chill (30-50%), Freeze & Electrocute Buildup Thresholds
poe1_or_stale_trap: Assuming Shock scales continuously from 5% to 50% by default or assuming all Lightning skills cause Electrocute.
poe2_live_rule: Shock applies a flat 20% increased damage taken base magnitude (8s on monsters, 4s on players; scaled by Shock Magnitude mods), with Shock chance proportional to Lightning hit vs Elemental Ailment Threshold. Chill slows by 30%-50% (<30% ignored). Freeze (Cold) and Electrocute (ONLY Lightning skills/supports explicitly stating Electrocute!) fill cumulative buildup bars against Freeze/Electrocute Thresholds. Base player Ailment Threshold is 50% of Max Life (1-Life CI characters MUST get '+Ailment/Stun Threshold from % of Max ES' passives/mods!).
source_ref: RePoE keywords.min.json[Shock, Chill, Freeze, Electrocute, AilmentThreshold] & PoB2 Misc.lua

title: Dual Stun System: Light Stun (15% Floor) vs Heavy Stun Bar
poe1_or_stale_trap: Treating Stun as a single mechanic or assuming Moving always causes Bleeding targets to take 3x damage without Aggravation.
poe2_live_rule: PoE2 has TWO stun mechanics: (1) Light Stun (0.5s interrupt; <15% chance treated as 0%; each recent stun within 4s raises player Light Stun threshold by +50% more) and (2) Heavy Stun (3.0s incapacitation when the Heavy Stun poise bar fills; players cannot be Heavy Stunned except during Raise Shield, Parry, Sprint end, or Mounted combat). Player Physical damage and Melee damage each grant 50% MORE Stun chance/buildup multiplicatively (2.25x combined).

title: Utility Flasks Do NOT Exist — 1 Life Flask + 1 Mana Flask + Up to 3 Belt Charms
poe1_or_stale_trap: Recommending Quicksilver, Granite, Jade, or Quartz Utility Flasks, Enkindling/Instilling Orbs, or piano-flask setups.
poe2_live_rule: Utility Flasks (and Quicksilver Flasks) do NOT exist in PoE2! Every character has strictly 1 Life Flask slot, 1 Mana Flask slot, and up to 3 Charm slots unlocked by Belt implicits/affixes (capped at 3). Charms trigger defensive effects automatically when their condition occurs (e.g. taking Fire damage, being Frozen/Stunned) using charges gained from monster Power kills, Checkpoints, and Town Wells.
formula_expr: FlaskSlots = 1 Life + 1 Mana; CharmSlots <= 3 (unlocked via Belt)

title: Waystone Modifier Count Controls Map Revives / Portals (0 Revives on 6-Mod Rare!)
poe1_or_stale_trap: Assuming every map grants 6 death portals regardless of how juiced the map is (PoE1), or assuming every PoE2 map is strictly 1-portal regardless of rarity (stale 0.1 rule).
poe2_live_rule: In PoE2 0.2-0.5.5, available revives per Waystone scale inversely with modifier count: Normal (0 mods) = 5 revives; Magic (2 mods) = 4 revives; 4-mod Rare = 2 revives; 6-mod Rare = 0 revives (dying once bricks the map). Boss Atlas Difficulty above 0 also reduces boss respawn attempts (capped at Difficulty 4).
formula_expr: Revives(0 mods)=5, Revives(2 mods)=4, Revives(4 mods)=2, Revives(6 mods)=0
source_ref: RePoE keywords.min.json[Waystone, AtlasDifficulty] & Patch 0.2-0.5 Atlas rules

title: Tablets Go Directly Into the Map Device (Stale Lost-Tower Slotting Trap!)
poe1_or_stale_trap: Telling players to slot Precursor Tablets inside completed Lost Towers on the Atlas (the obsolete 0.1-0.3 mechanic) or calling them Scarabs.
poe2_live_rule: In PoE2 0.5.5, Tablets (Breach, Ritual, Delirium, Expedition, Abyss, Irradiated, Overseer, Temple) are placed DIRECTLY into the Map Device alongside your Waystone to add mechanics and multipliers to your maps! Precursor Towers on the Atlas are run to defeat the boss and activate the Precursor Beacon, revealing a large fog radius and dropping a Tablet.

title: Patch 0.5 Masters of the Atlas (Jado, Hilda, Doryani), Trials & Pinnacle Bosses
poe1_or_stale_trap: Referencing Kirac, Maven, Searing Exarch, Eater of Worlds, or the Lord's Labyrinth for Ascendancy points.
poe2_live_rule: PoE2 0.5.5 features the Infinite Atlas with Masters of the Atlas (Jado, Hilda, Doryani) and mechanic-specific Atlas Passive Trees. Ascendancy Points 1-8 come from Trial of the Sekhemas (Honour) and/or Trial of Chaos (overhauled in 0.5.5) — there is NO Labyrinth. Core Pinnacles: Arbiter of Ash (+ Uber Arbiter via Crisis/Calamity fragments in Burning Monolith), Xesht (Breach), Olroth (Expedition), King in the Mists (Ritual), Simulacrum (Delirium), and Abyss Lords (Amanamu, Kurgal, Ulaman).
formula_expr: AscendancyPoints = 8 max (4 sets of 2 via Sekhemas / Trial of Chaos)

title: Zero Orb of Scouring, Zero Orb of Alteration, Zero PoE1 Crafting Bench
poe1_or_stale_trap: Advising 'Alt-spam for +2 skills, Imprint, Regal, then craft Prefixes Cannot Be Changed + Scour' — NONE of those exist in PoE2!
poe2_live_rule: Orb of Scouring, Orb of Alteration, Eternal Imprints, and the PoE1 Crafting Bench ('Prefixes/Suffixes Cannot Be Changed', 'Cannot Roll Attack/Caster Mods') DO NOT EXIST in PoE2! Dormant rows in raw BaseItemTypes.datc64 are unobtainable PoE1 leftovers. PoE2 crafting uses Forward Progression + In-Place Surgery (Tiered Orbs, Essences, Perfect Essences, Alloys, Desecration Bones, and Ritual/Abyss Omens) plus the 3-to-1 Reforging Bench.
source_ref: EE2 items.ndjson live item whitelist vs RePoE base_items.min.json

title: In-Game Modifier Tier 1 is BEST Since Patch 0.2.1 (Internal IDs Are Inverted!)
poe1_or_stale_trap: Either telling players 'In PoE2 Tier 1 is the worst tier and Tier 10 is the best' (stale 0.1.0 rule) OR reading RePoE/PoB2 mod ID 'Strength1' (+5-8 Str, ilvl 1) and calling it 'Tier 1'!
poe2_live_rule: Patch 0.2.1 reversed in-game item modifier tier numbering so Tier 1 (T1) is ALWAYS the strongest/highest tier on that base! However, internal GGG .datc64 / RePoE / PoB2 IDs (e.g. Strength1..Strength9) still number 1 as ilvl 1 (weakest). Tools MUST convert: display_tier = total_family_tiers_on_base - zero_based_asc_index.

title: Greater & Perfect Transmute / Augment / Regal / Exalt / Chaos Minimum Modifier Levels
poe1_or_stale_trap: Ignoring Greater and Perfect currency tiers or guessing wrong minimum ilvl cutoffs across Magic vs Rare orbs.
poe2_live_rule: PoE2 basic crafting orbs come in 3 strengths (Basic, Greater, Perfect) enforcing a Minimum Modifier Level floor on newly rolled tiers: (1) Transmutation & Augmentation: Greater = floor 55, Perfect = floor 70; (2) Regal, Exalted & Chaos: Greater = floor 35, Perfect = floor 50. Culling low-level tiers shrinks the denominator dramatically — unless your desired mod's highest tier is below the floor (or if no tier of a family meets the floor, check per-family eligibility).
source_ref: RePoE base_items.min.json[Currency*2, Currency*3] & PoE2DB item data

title: Regular Essences Are Magic->Rare Regals; Perfect & Corrupted Essences Are Rare Remove-1-Add-1 Swaps
poe1_or_stale_trap: Treating PoE2 Essences like PoE1 Essences/Alchemy Orbs that reforge a Normal or Rare item with 4-6 new random modifiers.
poe2_live_rule: PoE2 Essences work completely differently from PoE1: (1) Lesser, Normal, and Greater Essences (19 families) act as targeted Regal Orbs — they upgrade a MAGIC item to a RARE item, adding 1 deterministic guaranteed modifier while keeping existing Magic modifiers! (2) Perfect Essences (19 families) and Corrupted Essences (Horror, Hysteria, Insanity, Delirium, the Breach, the Abyss) apply to a RARE item, removing 1 random existing modifier and adding 1 guaranteed modifier (pair with Omen of Sinistral/Dextral Crystallisation to force removal from Prefixes or Suffixes only!).
formula_expr: Lesser/Normal/Greater: Magic -> Rare (+1 forced); Perfect/Corrupted: Rare -> Rare (-1 random [or P/S w/ Omen], +1 forced)

title: Patch 0.5 Verisium Anvil Runeforging & 13 Deterministic Alloys
poe1_or_stale_trap: Missing Patch 0.5's Verisium Anvil / Runeforging system or recommending phased-out Recombinators instead.
poe2_live_rule: Patch 0.5 (Return of the Ancients / Runes of Aldur) introduced Kalguuran Remnants & Verisium Runeforging: combining exact sequences of Runes (tracked in VerisiumCrafts.lua & remnants.json) crafts advanced Runes, Runeforged bases, Unique upgrades, and 13 Verisium Alloys (Runic, Adaptive, Protective, Expansive, Swift, Cyclonic, Prismatic, Mystic, Sovereign, Celestial, Transcendent, Runebinder's, Runefather's). Each Alloy acts on a Rare item to remove 1 random modifier and add 1 guaranteed high-end modifier.
formula_expr: Alloy: Rare -> Rare (-1 random mod, +1 guaranteed Alloy mod)
source_ref: PoB2 v0.23.1 Data/VerisiumCrafts.lua, EE2 remnants.json & RePoE base_items.min.json

title: Omen of Homogenising Exaltation/Coronation (Removed 0.4) & Recombinators (Phased Out 0.5)
poe1_or_stale_trap: Building crafting plans around 'Omen of Homogenising Exaltation' (0.1-0.3 meta) or 'Recombinators' (0.2-0.4 meta) in a live 0.5.5 league.
poe2_live_rule: GGG removed Omen of Homogenising Exaltation and Omen of Homogenising Coronation from drop pools in Patch 0.4 because tag-matching Exalts made crafting too deterministic, and phased out Recombinators in Patch 0.5 alongside the Verisium Runeforging overhaul. Legacy copies still appear in Standard trade dictionaries, so active-league planners MUST exclude them by default.

title: Active Crafting Omens: Sinistral (Prefix), Dextral (Suffix), Whittling & Catalysing
poe1_or_stale_trap: Confusing Sinistral vs Dextral sides or forgetting Omen of Whittling removes by lowest modifier required_level (not display tier number!).
poe2_live_rule: Right-clicked active Omens in inventory modify the next orb: 'Sinistral' ALWAYS targets Prefixes; 'Dextral' ALWAYS targets Suffixes — covering Exaltation (Exalt), Coronation (Regal), Alchemy (max P or S), Annulment (Annul), Erasure (Chaos removal), Crystallisation (Perfect/Corrupted Essence removal), and Necromancy (Desecration). Omen of Greater Exaltation/Annulment adds/removes 2 mods. Omen of Catalysing Exaltation consumes Ring/Amulet/Jewel Catalyst quality to boost matching mod tag weights. Omen of Whittling forces a Chaos Orb to remove the modifier with the LOWEST required_level (ties broken uniformly).
formula_expr: Sinistral -> Prefix; Dextral -> Suffix; Whittling -> argmin_m(m.required_level)

title: Abyssal Desecration (Jawbones, Ribs, Collarbones), Well of Souls & Boss Omens
poe1_or_stale_trap: Confusing Desecration with PoE1 Aisling/Veiled Chaos Orbs, trying to use Gnawed Bones on ilvl 82 endgame bases, or thinking an item can hold multiple Desecrated mods naturally.
poe2_live_rule: Abyssal Bones Desecrate a Rare item by slot: Jawbones (Weapon/Quiver), Ribs (Armour), Collarbones (Amulets/Rings/Belts). Bone tiers: Gnawed (ilvl <= 64 ONLY), Preserved (any ilvl, floor=1), Ancient (any ilvl, minimum modifier level = 40!). If 6 mods are full, Desecration removes 1 random mod first; items with a Desecrated mod cannot be Desecrated again (unless removed via Annul + Omen of Light, which removes Desecrated mods with 100% certainty!). Unveiling at the Well of Souls presents 3 choices without replacement (rerollable once via Omen of Abyssal Echoes); Omen of the Liege / Blackblooded / Sovereign guarantees Amanamu / Kurgal / Ulaman faction mods.
formula_expr: HitProb_Well = 1 - P(3 misses w/o replacement); w/ Echoes = 1 - (1 - HitProb_Well)^2

title: Essence of the Abyss & Mark of the Abyssal Lord Deterministic Target Loop
poe1_or_stale_trap: Risking a random 6-mod Desecration overwrite on finished prefixes/suffixes instead of isolating the slot with Essence of the Abyss.
poe2_live_rule: Essence of the Abyss (Corrupted Essence; pairable with Sinistral/Dextral Crystallisation to remove only a bad Prefix or Suffix) places a placeholder 'Mark of the Abyssal Lord' modifier on a Rare item. When you subsequently apply an Abyssal Bone, Desecration deterministically targets and replaces the Mark with the Unrevealed Desecrated modifier — protecting your other 5 finished affixes!

title: Fracturing Orb Locks 1 Random Mod on a Rare Item with >= 4 Modifiers (25% Optimal)
poe1_or_stale_trap: Attempting to use a Fracturing Orb on a 2-mod Magic or 3-mod Regal'd Rare item.
poe2_live_rule: Fracturing Orb requires a Rare item with AT LEAST 4 modifiers and permanently fractures 1 random modifier (probability 1/k for k in {4, 5, 6}; always fracture at exactly 4 mods for 25% max odds unless using placeholder manipulation). A Fractured mod can never be removed or altered by Annul, Chaos, Perfect Essence, or Desecration, and permanently blocks its mod family.
formula_expr: P(Fracture target) = 1 / k where k = ModCount >= 4 (max 0.25 at k=4)

title: Sanctification (Divine + Omen of Sanctification: 0.78x-1.22x) vs Vaal Corruption
poe1_or_stale_trap: Not knowing what 'Sanctified' items are on trade or trying to craft further on a Sanctified item.
poe2_live_rule: Using a Divine Orb while 'Omen of Sanctification' is active Sanctifies a Rare item: each modifier's numeric value is independently multiplied by a random factor in [78%, 122%] (capable of pushing +Skill Level or Spirit/Resist breakpoints past normal T1 caps!), locking the item against further currency crafting (standard Runes/Soul Cores with canSocketInCorruptedSanctified=true can still be socketed!). Vaal Orbs (+ Omen of Corruption to eliminate the no-change outcome) corrupt items unpredictably; Vaal Infusers push Quality up to 30% with corruption risk.
source_ref: RePoE keywords.min.json[Sanctified, Corrupted] & base_items.min.json[Omen of Sanctification]

title: Equipment Augment Sockets: Runes/Soul Cores/Idols CAN Be Overwritten (Stale 0.1 Trap!) + Shaman Bonded Mods
poe1_or_stale_trap: Warning players that 'once you socket a Rune into armour/weapons in PoE2, it is permanent forever and bricks the socket' (stale 0.1.0 launch behavior).
poe2_live_rule: In PoE2 0.5.5, standard Augments (Runes, Soul Cores, Azmeri Idols, Ancient Augments — max 1 Ancient Augment equipped at once) placed into Artificer's Orb sockets CANNOT be retrieved, but CAN be overwritten/replaced by socketing a new Augment! The ONLY exception is 'Socket-bound' Augments (such as Atziri's Soul Cores), which explicitly state they cannot be removed or replaced. Additionally, Runes and Idols carry secondary 'Bonded' modifiers active only when the Druid Shaman's 'Wisdom of the Maji' notable is allocated.
source_ref: RePoE keywords.min.json[Augment, SocketBound, Ancient, ShamanOnlyMods] & augments.min.json

title: Distilled / Liquid Emotions: Amulet Instilling AND Rare Jewel Deterministic Crafting
poe1_or_stale_trap: Assuming Delirium Distilled/Liquid Emotions are ONLY used to anoint/instill Amulets and Waystones.
poe2_live_rule: In PoE2 0.5.5, 3-combinations of Liquid Emotions instill Notable passives onto Amulets (and Delirium layers onto Waystones), AND individual Liquid Emotions (Diluted/Normal/Concentrated/Potent) apply directly to Rare Basic Jewels (and Ancient Liquid Emotions to Rare Time-Lost Jewels) to remove 1 random modifier and augment 1 guaranteed crafted Jewel modifier!
formula_expr: LiquidEmotion on Rare Jewel: -1 random mod, +1 guaranteed Delirium Jewel mod

title: Culling Strike Thresholds Scale by Monster Rarity (35% / 20% / 10% / 5%)
poe1_or_stale_trap: Assuming Culling Strike kills all enemies including Unique Pinnacle Bosses at 10% Life like PoE1.
poe2_live_rule: In PoE2, Culling Strike thresholds depend on monster rarity: Normal monsters = 35% Life, Magic monsters = 20% Life, Rare monsters = 10% Life, and Unique bosses = 5% Life!

title: Life/Mana/ES Leech Recovers Over 1 Second & Caps Per-Hit Input at 40,000 Damage
poe1_or_stale_trap: Applying PoE1's complex 2%/sec per instance, 10% max leech cap, 20% total leech rate cap formulas.
poe2_live_rule: In PoE2, each Hit with Leech recovers the leeched amount linearly over 1.0 second (modified by monster Leech Resistance), and hits dealing more than 40,000 total damage are treated as 40,000 damage for Leech calculations (EffectiveMaxDamageForLeech = 40000).

title: Equipped Body Armour & Shield Inherent Movement Speed Penalties
poe1_or_stale_trap: Ignoring hidden movement speed penalties on Strength Body Armours and Tower Shields, or forgetting PoE2's Sprint mechanic.
poe2_live_rule: Body Armours and Shields apply inherent hidden movement speed penalties based on attribute requirements (pure Str Body Armour has the largest penalty, Dex/Int lightest). Holding Dodge Roll transitions into Sprint (+50% movement speed, dodge_roll_sprint_minimum_time_ms=100), but getting Hit while Sprinting causes heavy stun vulnerability.
formula_expr: SprintSpeedBonus = +50% movement speed (stun vulnerable if hit)

title: Patch 0.4 Druid Class, Bear/Wolf/Wyvern Shapeshifting & Talisman Weapon Class
poe1_or_stale_trap: Saying Druid is unreleased in PoE2 (stale 0.1-0.3 info) or confusing PoE2 Talismans (a 2-Handed Martial Weapon class!) with PoE1 Talisman League amulets.
poe2_live_rule: Patch 0.4.0 (Last of the Druids) released the Str/Int Druid class with full Bear, Wolf, and Wyvern shapeshifting skills. Crucially, 'Talismans' in PoE2 are an equippable Weapon Class (used for Primal/Shapeshift attacks, rolling weapon attack prefixes/suffixes), NOT corrupted amulets like PoE1!
formula_expr: PoE2 Talisman = Martial Weapon Class (NOT Amulet)

title: Playable Classes in Patch 0.5.5 vs Shadow & Duelist Arriving in 1.0 (Dec 11, 2026)
poe1_or_stale_trap: Recommending Shadow (Assassin/Trickster/Saboteur), Duelist (Slayer/Gladiator/Champion), Marauder, or Scion builds in PoE2 0.5.5, or saying Huntress/Druid aren't out yet.
poe2_live_rule: Through Patch 0.5.5, PoE2 has 8 playable classes (Warrior, Ranger, Huntress [0.2], Mercenary, Sorceress, Witch, Monk, Druid [0.4]) across 23 Ascendancies. Shadow and Duelist (plus Acts 5 & 6) launch in Version 1.0.0 on December 11, 2026; Scion does not exist in PoE2.
formula_expr: LiveClasses_0_5_5 = {Warrior, Ranger, Huntress, Mercenary, Sorceress, Witch, Monk, Druid}

title: Vaal Temple / Incursion Currencies: Architect's Orb, Vaal Cultivation Orb & Orbs of Sacrifice
poe1_or_stale_trap: Looking for PoE1 Locus of Corruption Altar rooms instead of PoE2's itemized Vaal Temple currencies.
poe2_live_rule: Patch 0.4's Vaal Temple introduced itemized corruption currencies: Architect's Orb (double-corrupts an already Corrupted Equipment/Jewel or destroys it), Vaal Cultivation Orb (mutates up to 2 mods on a Vaal Unique or transforms another Unique into a Corrupted Unique), Orbs of Sacrifice (Yaomac/Kopec/Kamasa/Yugul — upgrade a Corruption Enchantment on Rare Weapon/Armour/Jewellery/Jewel while removing a random mod), Ancient Infuser (corrupts a Tablet), and Core Destabiliser (mutates a Soul Core).
formula_expr: ArchitectsOrb: Corrupted Item -> Twice Corrupted | Destroyed

title: Gold is Account-Bound Utility Currency (Passive Respec, Gambling & Instant Buyout Trade Fees)
poe1_or_stale_trap: Telling players to buy Orbs of Regret to respec their passive tree.
poe2_live_rule: Orbs of Regret do NOT drop in PoE2! Passive Tree and Ascendancy respecs cost Gold (scaling from 15 Gold at level 1 up to ~10,129 Gold per point at high level; Atlas passive respec = 5,000 Gold). Non-tradable Gold also pays Alva's Currency Exchange fees, Asynchronous Instant Buyout trade fees, and NPC Gambling.

title: Player Item Rarity (IIR) 100–125% Sweet Spot, Area Rarity Multiplier & Negative-Rarity Farming
poe1_or_stale_trap: Assuming PoE1's rule that Item Rarity ignores currency drops, stacking 300%+ IIR at the cost of clear speed on Day 1, or ignoring Negative Rarity for white crafting bases.
poe2_live_rule: In PoE2, Player Item Rarity (IIR) upgrades both equipment AND currency drop tiers and multiplies with Area/Map Rarity, but suffers steep diminishing returns past ~125–150%. Target ~100–125% Player IIR once clear speed and resists are locked (Day 1 prioritizes Atlas speed over IIR). Conversely, Negative Player IIR (<0%, e.g. negative-rarity Ventor's Gamble) suppresses Normal->Magic/Rare upgrades to flood ilvl 82 / Exceptional (21%+ quality / 3-socket) white crafting bases.
source_ref: PoB2 CalcPerform.lua EffectiveLootRarityMod & PoE2 0.5 Mapping Economy

title: Patch 0.5.5 Forbidden Rites: Campaign Ritual Cascades, Sacred Blooms & Viridian Wildwood Wisps
poe1_or_stale_trap: Treating Ritual as a low-yield side mechanic or forgetting that Ritual Tablets directly boost Viridian Wildwood Wisp yields in 0.5.5.
poe2_live_rule: Patch 0.5.5 Forbidden Rites adds Campaign Rituals (with cascading Boss Ritual clusters where killing the boss inside a Ritual carries it into subsequent altars) and endgame Sacred Blooms. Applying a Sacred Bloom to an Atlas cluster spawns Viridian Wildwood entrances where Azmeri Wisps empower map monsters: Primal Wisps upgrade Normal->Magic, Vivid Wisps add Rare modifiers, Wild Wisps multiply Item Rarity, and White Wisps restore light/reveal paths. Slotting Ritual Tablets in the Map Device on Sacred Bloom maps directly increases Wildwood Wisp density.
formula_expr: SacredBloom(AtlasCluster) + RitualTablet(MapDevice) -> Amplified Wildwood Wisps + Ritual Omens
source_ref: PoE2 Patch 0.5.5 Forbidden Rites Release Notes

title: Patch 0.5 Origins of Divinity Fortress Progression, Atlas Masters (Jado/Hilda/Doryani) & +1 Waystones
poe1_or_stale_trap: Grinding low-tier map bonus objectives for Atlas points or expecting mundane map bosses to drop +1 tier Waystones.
poe2_live_rule: Patch 0.5 replaced basic map bonus Atlas points with the Origins of Divinity Precursor Fortress (clearing Towers, Gateways, Enigma Chambers, and Halls grants Atlas points; defeating Quest Arbiter of Divinity auto-completes Fortress sections). Only 1 Atlas Master is active at a time: Jado (Partial Translations/Long Days/Unforeseen Treats — versatile tablets & Lineage gems), Hilda (Breeding Season/Mighty Prey — rare density & powerful bosses), or Doryani (Improved Calibration/Disengaged Safeties/Dam the River — map/irradiated manipulation). Powerful Map Bosses drop +1 tier Waystones.
source_ref: PoE2 Patch 0.5 Return of the Ancients Patch Notes

title: Trial of the Sekhemas: Honour Pool (Life+ES), 75% Honour Resist Cap & Double Unique Relic Breakpoint
poe1_or_stale_trap: Running 4-floor Trial of the Sekhemas without capping 75% Honour Resistance or stacking Player IIR instead of Relic Quantity for Zarokh.
poe2_live_rule: Maximum Honour in Trial of the Sekhemas scales from your combined Life + Energy Shield pool (mitigated by Armour, Evasion, Block, and capped 75% Honour Resistance on Relics). Stacking >=120% increased Quantity of Relics dropped by Monsters on Relics pushes Zarokh, the Temporal into dropping double Unique Relics (hunting Against the Darkness and The Last Flame for Temporalis) alongside Day 1–3 Ascendancy carry income.
source_ref: PoE2 Trial of the Sekhemas Mechanics & Relic Formulas

title: Patch 0.5 Orb of Alchemy Works Directly on Magic Items (Wipes & Rerolls as Rare)
poe1_or_stale_trap: Assuming Orbs of Alchemy only work on Normal (white) items as in PoE1 and discarding Magic Waystones or crafting bases.
poe2_live_rule: Since Patch 0.5, Orbs of Alchemy can be applied directly to Magic items as well as Normal items, wiping the existing Magic modifiers and reforging the item as a fresh Rare — smoothing early Waystone rolling and league-start rare crafting without Orbs of Scouring.
